resources.string: SpaceSaver looks at your photos and videos to find ones that can be made smaller, then shrinks them on your phone.
Without access to photos and videos, SpaceSaver can\'t find anything to compress.
Access to photos and videos is turned off. Turn on \"Photos and videos\" in SpaceSaver\'s settings to continue.
Works fully offline: no internet permission
Nothing is deleted without your OK
SpaceSaver can only see selected photos. Allow full access to find more savings.
